title: Study Evaluating BENEFIX in Previously Treated Patients With Hemophilia B
brief_summary: To assess efficacy and safety of BeneFix® for prophylaxis in "Short-term" therapy and on demand therapy for all bleeding episodes of subjects with hemophilia B.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with moderate to severe hemophilia B ( \< 5% circulating factor IX activity) having acute hemorrhage or requiring "short-term therapy" for intermittent secondary prophylaxis regimens.
2. HIV seropositive ( asymptomatic) or seronegative subjects.
3. No history or detectable inhibitors.
